method: 30 claims (10 per sheet, random.Random(20261030).sample over each file) read twice by eye. Pass 1: per-claim crops at 3x (300 x 220 scan px minimum window, legend swatches of the sheet and colour beside; these first-pass crops were superseded by the stored native-resolution crops in crops_state/, which cover the same windows). Pass 2, blind: claim ids hidden, order shuffled, numbered 1-30, in 2x tiles of 330 x 235 scan px (tmp/troopmaps/ls_mont/cal2_*.jpg, index cal_index.json). Agreement is between the two reads, not against an external truth (none exists). The full pass then used 5x (Union anchored) / 3.5x (Confederate anchored) / 2.33x (label-only) tiles, a larger zoom than either calibration pass, after 5x checks showed that the wedge of the Union first-position bars is hidden in the dense blue ink below 5x (TMJ1-020/037/038/048).
